scope: Only explicitly registered new platform TypeScript/JavaScript/JSON files and Git-added lines of registered existing files; no game imports or game execution
rules: No code comments, TypeScript any or dynamic execution
No imports from games or workspace escape
Integer numeric literals and deterministic logic in businessSources
AudioContext physical destination cannot receive output; platformAudioSources use a native MediaStream destination
Only declared platform audio may create native audio players or AudioContext
All temporary output is explicitly in a declared local workspace root
Existing sources inspect added lines only; new sources are inspected in full
